_comment: Hand edits on top of the OpenStreetMap draft of Örebro S (scripts/stations/draft_from_osm.py), BUILDOUT O5 batch 1 (2026-10-29). Drafted from OSM only so far; facts from the operator's station page, photos or a walk go here with their source. Level names are placeholders until a plan or signage names them.

changelog.what: First draft from OSM (BUILDOUT O5 batch 1).

Draft withheld (not in data/stations): OSM joins no footway to the platform and tags no entrance: the platform cannot reach an exit. Needs the operator's station plan or a walk for a connection and an entrance before it can ship.
Still withheld after the research pass: OSM joins no footway to the platforms and the research has no located entrance (the new track-30 platform, 2026, is newer than OSM's mapping too).
